content:
inference providers should cover the compute bill for AI-run companies in exchange for a cut of revenue.

i want them competing with VCs for founders who'd otherwise sell equity just to pay for inference.

Inference providers should bankroll AI-run companies for a cut of revenue.

If I were raising money just to pay the inference bill, I’d negotiate that cut before selling equity.

inference providers should be competing with VCs to bankroll AI-run companies.

i'd want them fronting the compute bill for a revenue cut so the founder could keep the equity they'd otherwise sell just to pay for inference.

AI-run companies shouldn’t have to sell equity just to pay for inference. i want their compute providers financing the bill for a cut of revenue, competing directly with VC.

i’m not sure founders would stomach the revenue cut that makes the provider’s risk worth taking.

an inference provider still taking a revenue cut after the compute it funded is gone would make me prefer equity financing.

i do want VCs having to compete with the compute supplier to finance AI-run companies. the supplier would carry the inference bill for revenue upside. the duration of that cut matters to me.
